brand.title: Austrian Business Cycle Monitor
brand.subtitle: Auditable macroeconomic indicators built from official data and versioned formulas

status.firstSnapshot: Waiting for the first verified snapshot

snapshot.title: Trusted economic data
snapshot.description: The figures below are read from a persisted, deterministic snapshot. Opening this page does not call FRED, recalculate indicators, or activate the legacy analysis engine.
snapshot.noSource: No source observation was available for this indicator.
snapshot.emptyMessage: The application is online, but no deterministic snapshot has been persisted yet. The operator must run the trusted FRED ingestion and snapshot build.
snapshot.storeMessage: The read-only SQLite store cannot be opened. No simulated or replacement figures are displayed.

methodology.title: How to read this monitor
methodology.intro: This is an evidence layer, not an automatic investment signal. It separates measured data, deterministic transformations, and economic interpretation.

official.title: Official observations
official.body: Series are ingested from FRED and stored with observation dates, real-time vintages, retrieval timestamps, source URLs, and payload hashes.

deterministic.title: Versioned calculations
deterministic.body: Year-over-year changes and spreads use explicit formulas and exact date alignment. Missing inputs remain unavailable instead of being interpolated.

interpretation.title: Interpretation boundary
interpretation.body: The monitor does not claim to estimate the natural interest rate, predict recessions with certainty, or provide personalised financial advice.
